text:
07:10 - 15:35 means the time difference going backwards from 07:10 to 15:35 on the clock.  
07:10 is earlier in the day than 15:35, so going backward crosses midnight.  
From 07:10 back to 00:00 is 7 hours 10 minutes. From 00:00 back to 15:35 is -15 hours 35 minutes (or +8 hours 25 minutes forward from 15:35 to midnight).  
Total backward = 7:10 + (24:00 - 15:35) = 7:10 + 8:25 = 15 hours 35 minutes.  
But since we are doing 07:10 - 15:35 = (7:10 + 24:00) - 15:35 = 31:10 - 15:35 = 15:35.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 15:35
